notes: Machine-readable dataset catalog. Maps each source to classifier heads and expected class labels.

plantvillage.name: PlantVillage Dataset
plantvillage.limitation: Lab conditions — must be combined with field-condition datasets to avoid overfitting to clean backgrounds

plantdoc.name: PlantDoc Dataset
plantdoc.advantage: Real-world backgrounds and lighting — critical for generalization

mendeley_leaf_disease.name: Plant Leaf Disease Dataset (Mendeley)
mendeley_leaf_disease.note: Use raw images only for training — augmented set may contain data leakage if augmented images overlap train/test split

leaf_disease_segmentation.name: Leaf Disease Segmentation Dataset
leaf_disease_segmentation.advantage: Provides lesion masks needed for affected_area_ratio severity estimation

riceleaf_disease.name: RiceLeaf Disease Detector
riceleaf_disease.note: Small dataset — use as supplementary, combine with PlantVillage rice classes

plant_leaf_detection.name: PlantLeafDiseaseDetection
plant_leaf_detection.note: Largely PlantVillage derivative — check for overlap before using as independent test set

open_agriculture_journal.name: Open Agriculture Journal — CNN Transfer Learning Study
open_agriculture_journal.use: Methodology reference for transfer learning strategy and validation approach

plantvillage_to_condition_classifier.description: 38 PlantVillage classes mapped to 3 top-level condition classes

recommended_split_strategy.description: Split by plant/source ID rather than randomly to prevent data leakage from visually similar duplicates
recommended_split_strategy.note: Test set must be completely isolated — never used during training or threshold selection
